about_the_game:
The "He" who never arrives need eyes and armsfeet.

Thus,"unsuccessful" priest cultivates vulnerable monsters day after night.

Survivors take refuge in the "Village".

They [bless] you.

·Ascetics·

Today-again-Seal eyes tightly

Planting

Which came first, the chicken or the egg? Obviously, it’s the plant.

Plants are the origin of all animals’ birth; in other words, every animal is cultivated from planting (Same for humans?)

Your Animal will take care of plants,or become glorious warriors.

Mature crops are the most essential raw materials—any building requires them.

As a former magical farmer, growing things is not bad for you: a kettle shovel, chanting a spell, waiting, and reaping with a scythe.

Just take care of them and don't let your monsters sneak-attack(They're really gluttonous.)

Battle

Environment is constantly changing, and "Evil" accumulate continuously.

Generally speaking, each invasion mission targets creating enough waves of monsters (don’t let them actually invade the village). As long as the waves meet the standard, the foolish informant will send you back.

Only if the threat level is high enough that the angels have the authority to provide you with greater support [probably]. The weapons they offer can sometimes be extremely powerful,sometimes utterly useless.

You can freely switch between your primary and secondary weapons, using them flexibly.

short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!
